messages:
nina: kicking off orders.add_customer_index in 5m. plan: add nullable col, backfill, then create index concurrently. canary on shard-2.
sam: I'll quiesce replicas and run the drain script.
dba-lee: prefer shadow-table backfill if concurrent index contends. abort if any ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock or deadlock. threshold: lock > 7s -> pause.
deploybot: migration run started (id: mj-5110) step: add-column -> success.
sam: draining replicas now, connections down to 4.
deploybot: step: backfill-chunked started (chunk_size=200, throttle_ms=50).
deploybot: ERROR: index create (concurrent) failed on shard-2: could not obtain lock on relation "orders". blocked by pid=5581
nina: hitting holdpoint. pause mj-5110.
deploybot: mj-5110 paused at step create-index (reason: lock-wait).
dba-lee: plan: cancel blocker pid, if still blocked switch to shadow-table mode and patch params: chunk_size=50 throttle=100ms. schedule index for next maintenance slot.
chris: applied runtime pin redwood/api:v2026-04-12 for this window to avoid schema-read changes. feature flag for new index remains off.
oncall-rita: I'm on call; monitoring replication lag and locks. will escalate if lag > 20s.
sam: updated migration params -> `curl -X PATCH https://deploy.internal/migrations/mj-5110 -d '{"mode":"shadow","chunk_size":50,"throttle_ms":100}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"`
deploybot: params accepted; mj-5110 set to shadow backfill.
deploybot: mj-5110 resumed (shadow backfill). monitoring holds: auto-pause if lock > 7s or lag > 20s.
dba-lee: good to continue. will watch for deadlocks.
release-bot: release-note queued: "orders.add_customer_index paused due to lock contention; resumed with shadow-table backfill and index scheduled during maintenance." (PR #8359).
nina: will post final status to #ops when index successfully created and feature flag flipped. :white_check_mark:
